source_evidence: All20 completed prose/caption predictions compared with source scans82/87/91 and all10 crop boundaries. Both model readings cover every intended prose line and the six separate mode captions; musical-sign tables are outside these text crops and remain explicit source-image regions. Word, accent and breathing disagreements in the prose remain variants. Several short mode captions are misspelled by both models and require the separately recorded named source adjudication; this review does not treat raw agreement as proof of correctness. The initial ται on scan82 is a page continuation, not a separate word.
